t: r/Gamecube on Reddit: Shout out to thrifty GC fans, the Veanic brand Wavebird clone is great.
s: May 23, 2018 - Both the Cirka and Veanic feel better. Maybe neither of those would survive 4 years of constant sweaty Melee through college, but I also don't play as often or as rigorously nowadays and I am happy with a $20 option. I will own up if this thing croaks in a few months, but I would also refuse to throw down to buy a Wavebird unless it is in phenomenal condition (and I can actually road test it).
